assessment.provenance: Actual private Next/compiler and untouched-exporter bytes from base ca54302adc258ff99cb0bed3e5c8d5ce41caede1 and a declared dirty working-preview. Temporary technical admission inside an isolated clone served inspection only and supplies no editorial acceptance.
assessment.reconstruction: Exact rollback of 3 managed MDX files (W1, W2, B32) and 7 raw claim records recovers the exact cb2584d4 predecessor pin before #161 -> older qualifiers.
assessment.guards: Independent adversarial publication-engineering audit verified fail-closed preview/pin guards, exact W1 U W2 = B32 parity, hardened rendered TABLE validation in scripts/reader-closing-synthesis.mjs (all 7 adversarial PoCs rejected), B32/W1/W2 post-copyedit addressPin (58d6b49e...), and CSS zero-drift (be180e5d...), concluding Round 2 unconditional PASS (0 BLOCKER, 0 MAJOR, 0 MINOR).
assessment.actual: Comparison of all article projections identifies the exact 4 changed articles (B30 web, W1, W2, and print B32) and 4 changed public artifacts. All 468 manifest payloads and 40 case downloads verified.
assessment.browser: Passed 30 responsive viewport/theme checks across W1, W2 & /print × 5 widths (375–1440px) × light/dark (0 overflow, 0 errors; DOM audit: W1 10 claims, W2 19 claims + 7-row table, B32 29 claims + 7-row table).
assessment.limits: Clean production build (dirty:false), source PR/CI/merge, live EdgeOne byte/guard qualification and exact root submodule integration remain required after this scoped acceptance.
